transcript.answer: I couldn't find a calendar date for the removal. The sources identify it by issue number and engine release, not by date. Otto's own frame recorder was dropped by issue #181, "Adopt HAL Engine's exported recordedFrames in the support agent". That change landed on HAL Engine 0.10.0. It deleted the local recorder, the committed nine-frame fixture and the CI diff step that checked them. The recorder had been built by #14. It was replaced by `recordedFrames`, which HAL Engine now exports (engine issue #130). Tests replay those frames instead. The import ban on `@re-cinq/hal-engine` in `apps/web` was narrowed so the engine can be a devDependency imported only from `*.test.*` files. #192 landed before #181, so the recorder's `hal.v1` offer requirement (FR-113) lapsed when #181 removed the recorder. The support-agent-hal-subprotocol-offer spec (FR-007) confirms the recorder was removed with #181.
sources: specs/support-agent-chat/spec.md (Reconciled Decisions 9, 10, 11, 14; Dependencies and Open Questions; Issue Map)
